caption: Expense report filed from orbit. Mileage pending.
The check arrived at high noon. He did not blink.
Every cash register in town, finally in tune.
Extra parmesan is not a line item. It is a lifestyle.
Delivery fee waived. Skyscraper surcharge applied.
A grocery run, at speeds the store does not recommend.
A deep dive into the receipts. Some were waterlogged.
The summit of Mount Online Shopping. Free returns.
Pit stop: four tires, two coffees, one receipt.
They came for treasure and left with heirloom tomatoes.
A fully reconciled month. Nobody saw it coming.
